1) I say that, Petitioners was original owner of the land bearing Gat No. 502/2 total adm.
1.84 R situated at Village - Bahirewadi, Tal - Aajara Dist. Kolhapur.
2) Village-Bahirewadi, Tal - Aajara, Dist. Kolhapur is not in Benefited zone of the Ambeahol Project.
3) I say that, deemed date of Ambeahol Project was 31/07/2000 and slab of H 3-23 R was fixed.
4) I say and submit that, as on deemed date above mentioned of said Project, total holding of Petitioners was H 1-84

R. Out of total holding of land, Petitioners voluntarily handed over the vacant and peaceful possession of land adm. H 1- 84 R out of Gat no. 502/ in Village - Bahirewadi,
Tal - Aajara, Dist Kolhapur.
5) Accordingly, Name of Respondent/District Resettlement Officer was mutated to the 7/12 extract of the suit land vide mutation entry no.l879 dated 07/05/2002
Herein annexed and marked as "Exhibit R-1" is the copy of mutation entry dated 07/05/2002.

6) I say and submit that, Petitioner had voluntarily handed over the possession of the land bearing,
Gat No. 502/2 Adm. H 1.84 R.
The said land is not allotted to Project Affected Persons, because this land is hot in benefited zone.

7) I say and submit that petitioner, suit land Gat No. 502/2 total adm. H. 1-84 R situated at Village - Bahirewadi, Tal -- Aajara Dist. Kolhapur owned by Petitioner is neither in the Benefited zone of Ambeahol project nor it has been handed Husen 3 43 WP-1500-2019.doc over / allotted to -any Project Affected Persons of any project.

As per provisions of Maharashtra Project Affected Persons Rehabilitation Act, 1999 only those lands which are in the benefited zone of that particular project can be acquired or handed over to Government through voluntarily handing over.

entities.text: Maharashtra Project Affected Persons Rehabilitation Act, 1999
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Thus, voluntarily handing of land by Petitioner is void-ab initio.
Therefore, there is no question of paying ground rent or interest to present Petitioner.
Also, said land of Petitioner is no more needed or any purpose."
2. After taking this stand, the contention of the Petitioner regarding compensation is being contested.

However, as regards the possession as to whether the same is with the Petitioner or the State Government and if it is with the State what steps the State Government intends to take in the light of the above mentioned stand, the learned AGP seeks time to file additional affidavit.
3. Stand over to 15 February 2024.
( M.M. SATHAYE, J.) ( NITIN JAMDAR, J.)
